hypothesis: Native tree models repeatedly overfit unstable fine partitions, while the existing linear baseline omits high-cardinality player-context crosses. A signed-hashed, strongly regularized averaged logistic model can estimate many explicit pitcher/batter/context effects with global shrinkage, then contribute a low-correlation R-only correction to exact-C.

novelty_audit.existing_linear: v2 linear used the base+E14 columns with ordinary one-hot encoding and no explicit high-cardinality player-context cross library.
novelty_audit.existing_factorization: v5 matchup factorization imposed low-rank pitcher-batter structure. This candidate instead uses independently shrunk sparse crosses and no latent factorization.
novelty_audit.existing_catboost: CatBoost categorical CTRs are nonlinear target statistics; this candidate is a convex sparse linear model with averaged SGD and signed hashing.

legality.custom_inputs: current row raw columns and official row-local asof_* values only

candidate_family.inference_route: F rows remain exactly parent; only R rows receive the candidate blend
candidate_family.feature_contract: fixed semantic bins, main effects, and the explicit crosses defined in run_v5_hashed_cross_source.py; no learned target encoder
selection_order: maximize minimum full-score gain over 2020 and 2021
maximize minimum R-score gain over 2020 and 2021
candidate_family.collision_robustness: The selected alpha must also have positive minimum R gain at the other locked hash dimension.

source_protocol.on_fail: Close hashed-cross averaged logistic without reading 2022+ candidate labels.
source_protocol.on_pass: Freeze dimension, alpha, gamma, and feature contract before untouched 2022/2023 development.
